text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Mile CS is finally here! In 
preparation for the showdown against Taiki 
Shuttle, Hishi Akebono's body is in 
absolute top shape!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sensing a drive for victory she rarely 
showed, the stands erupted into a frenzy. 
Hishi Akebono was enveloped in thunderous 
cheers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Taiki Shuttle's fans weren't 
about to be outdone! As Taiki Shuttle 
declared her certain victory, they sent 
her off with thunderous applause.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Sparks fly across the racetrack. The 
curtain finally rises on a nail-biting 
showdown!
